name: Lune ~y su ilusión~
source:
You are Daren. One day you decide to visit an old market from your childhood, but after falling asleep, you wake up in an empty place where you only meet one girl; Lune.

[From [url=https://eroraen.itch.io/lune]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演达伦。某天，你决定重访童年时常去的老集市，却在那里睡着了。醒来后，你发现自己身处空无一人的地方，只遇见了一位女孩——露恩。

[摘自[url=https://eroraen.itch.io/lune]itch.io[/url]]
